Essential knots

Four knots cover most field needs: a loop, a bend, a hitch and a binding knot.

Bowline

The bowline makes a fixed loop that will not slip and is easy to untie after loading. Tie it around a tree or for a rescue harness.

Clove hitch

Fast to tie and adjustable, the clove hitch secures a rope to a post or a tarp grommet line.

Square knot

Joins two ropes of equal size for light lashing. Never use it for load-bearing life-safety work.

Figure-eight

Won't jam under heavy load; the standard stopper knot for climbing and rappel setups.
